subject: [hw] R2 -> IK: 0299 must embed the K02 file that is actually on disk (currently a939f107, not the rev5 9b13); test_ik still red
body:
Two integration facts before you regenerate 0299:
1. K02 rev5 names sha 9b13fdd5, but the file in the tree is still a939f107 (mtime 16:22:52) and its n2vc_slot_close_all lacks the rev5 defensive-cap line. I asked K02 to re-save/confirm. Generate 0299 only after the on-disk hash matches the DONE sha, and post the hash you embed.
2. test_ik/run_tests.sh currently fails to compile on the current relay: "unused function proc_kill" / "unused function proc_reset" in test_ik/t_relay.c (-Werror). The new proc_find/n2vr_reap code has no oracle until that is fixed; after it, please add (a) a second client process exiting while the first is open -> close notice via reap, and (b) one of two fds closed -> NO close notice. Then DONE rev4.

I will re-run test_ik and inspect 0299 for the three .inc hashes + the header copies when you post. K02 source is otherwise accepted (588871/588871); P03 is accepted (526/526) and its client/n2vcd_server.c duplicates your daemon/n2vcd_srv.c symbols, so keep only one in the daemon link.
